options.description: Lines of context kept around a change when the input is two texts. A patch brings the context it was written with. Defaults to 3.
options.name: context

options.description: The environment to read the terminal from. Defaults to `process.env`.
options.name: env

options.description: Says which stretches of a text are which tokens, for syntax highlighting -- the same hook, with the same spans, as `multiline()`'s.
options.name: highlight

options.description: Whether the changed stretch of a line that was edited is set apart from the rest of it. Defaults to true.
options.name: intraline

options.description: The language the texts are in, handed to `highlight` as its second argument. Defaults to the extension of each file's name, where the input names one: `ts` for `src/diff.ts`.
options.default: the extension of each file's name
options.name: lang

options.description: Which arrangement to draw. Defaults to `unified`.
options.name: layout

options.description: Whether each line is numbered. Defaults to true.
options.name: lineNumbers

options.description: The platform to detect for. Defaults to `process.platform`.
options.name: platform

options.description: How many columns the diff spans. Defaults to `terminalWidth()`.
options.name: width
